statement: Let changes(seq) be the number of adjacent unequal pairs in seq (0 if len(seq)<2). The function returns a result r, and r equals the maximum length of a subsequence seq of nums (obtained by deleting zero or more elements while preserving order; empty allowed) such that changes(seq) <= k. Equivalently, r = max { L | there exist 0 <= i_0 < ... < i_{L-1} < len(nums) and the sequence [nums[i_0],...,nums[i_{L-1}]] has at most k indices j with 0 <= j < L-1 and nums[i_j] != nums[i_{j+1}] }.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9. Indices are 0-based.

statement: Let changes(seq) be the number of adjacent unequal pairs in seq. The function returns a result r, and there exists a subsequence seq of nums with len(seq) = r and changes(seq) <= k. (A subsequence is obtained by deleting zero or more elements from nums while preserving order.)
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let changes(seq) be the number of adjacent unequal pairs in seq. The function returns a result r, and for every subsequence seq of nums with changes(seq) <= k, len(seq) <= r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result (it does not fail, panic, or overflow) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r, and 1 <= r <= len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let count(nums,v) = #{ i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v }. The function returns a result r, and r = max { count(nums,v) | v is an integer }, i.e. r is the maximum frequency of any value in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); k = 0; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: With changes(seq) counting adjacent unequal pairs, the function returns a result r, and r = min(len(nums), k + 1).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; for all 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j].

statement: The function returns a result r, and r = len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; let C = #{ i | 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 and nums[i] != nums[i+1] }; assume C <= k.

statement: Let count(nums,v) = #{ i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v } and M = max { count(nums,v) | v is an integer }. The function returns a result r, and r >= M.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r >= min(len(nums), k + 1).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let count(nums,v) = #{ i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v } and M = max { count(nums,v) | v is an integer }. The function returns a result r, and r <= min(len(nums), (k + 1) * M).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let f(t) be the maximum length of a subsequence of nums with at most t adjacent unequal pairs, for any integer t >= 0. The function returns a result r, and for every integer t with k <= t, f(t) >= r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r also equals the maximum length of a subsequence of rev(nums) with at most k adjacent unequal pairs, where rev(nums)[i] = nums[len(nums)-1-i] for 0 <= i < len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every array nums' of the same length as nums such that for all i,j with 0 <= i,j < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[j] iff nums'[i] = nums'[j], the maximum length of a subsequence of nums' with at most k adjacent unequal pairs is also r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500; 0 <= k <= min(len(nums), 25); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.
